summary: Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 1) of the figure with points A, B, C, D, E, F, O. Solid segments A-B, A-C, B-C, F-D, D-E, F-B, B-E and dashed segments A-O-E, C-O-D, F-O, B-O are drawn. The critic scored it 0.9 with no must-repair issues; the only remaining note is that the point labels render slightly smaller than in the original.
